entries.title: Reviewers no longer ask you what your approved plan already decided
entries.body: When a reviewer finds something your approved plan already answers, it sends the fix to the builder instead of asking you, even when the builder had its own reason for a different way. A question about your plan still reaches you when the plan cannot be built as written or a fact changed since you approved it, and the card then quotes the plan.
entries.noPicture: This changes which cards reach the screen, not how any card or view looks.
